Graduate Programs
Our M.S. and Ph.D. programs in Pharmaceutical Science allow you to pursue a specialization to develop expertise and leadership in high-impact fields, unlocking career opportunities in academia, pharmaceutical companies, regulatory agencies, clinical research, and beyond.
M.S./Ph.D. Specializations
Health Outcomes
Improve healthcare systems by researching cost-effectiveness, patient care quality, and health policies.
learn more
Medicinal Chemistry and Pharmacognosy
Develop new drugs from natural or synthetic sources, enhancing treatments for various diseases.
learn more
Pharmaceutics and Pharmacokinetics
Optimize drug delivery, ensuring medications are safe, effective, and reach the intended target.
learn more
Pharmacy and Toxicology
Assess drug safety, prevent toxic exposures, and advance therapeutic practices while protecting public health.
learn more
Online Programs
Medication Outcomes Graduate Certificate
Learn to measure the relationship between medical treatments and outcomes achieved in real-world environments.
learn more
M.S. in Health Outcomes and Data Analytics
Gain the training and skills necessary to make data-driven decisions and gain insights to improve patients’ lives.
learn more
